d: Bhuvneshwar Kumar's comeback to Team India after 4 years hasn't gone to plan. After a stunning IPL resurgence with Royal Challengers Bengaluru where he took 45 wickets across IPL 2025 and IPL 2026 and won RCB two titles at Chinnaswamy, the 36-year-old veteran fast bowler struggled in the India vs New Zealand T20I series with just 1 wicket in 4 matches and an economy of 11.25, sparking a big India selection debate with Irfan Pathan questioning his place over young pacers like Mayank Yadav and Arshdeep Singh. But does one tough series erase two years of IPL dominance and should Bhuvi still…
